sentences.text: The scheme is known as the Scheme for Comprehensive National Programme for the Support of Agriculture and Horticulture Research (SCNPSAAHR).
It aims to enhance agricultural productivity and sustainability through research and development.
The objectives include promoting innovative agricultural practices and improving the quality of agricultural education.
Benefits include financial assistance for research projects and capacity building for agricultural scientists.
Eligibility criteria typically include research institutions and universities engaged in agricultural research.
The application process involves submitting a detailed project proposal to the relevant authorities.
The timeline for project approval and funding disbursement varies based on the specific project and its requirements.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare.
Additional details may include collaborations with state governments and agricultural universities for effective implementation.
